instruction: Candid outdoor full shot from a high angle of a couple walking down a rocky path next to a marble wall. The woman in the white sweater and beige hat (R1) on the left looks towards the man while touching the marble wall with her right hand. The man in the brown sweater and dark hat (R2) on the right walks down, holding her hand. Soft natural daylight highlights the cool blue-gray marble and the warm tones of their sweaters.
